what: Aktueller Hundebestand der Stadt Zürich: the city's dog register on the reference day 2026-09-30, one row per dog, 10,106 dogs, 35 columns (owner's age group, sex and statistical quarter; the dog's breeds, breed type, sex, birth year, age and colour). Kept by the Hundekontrolle of the Stadtpolizei Zürich, published by Open Data Zürich (Statistik Stadt Zürich). Dataset page: https://data.stadt-zuerich.ch/dataset/sid_stapo_aktueller_hundebestand_monat_od1003
rights: Committed: the dataset's licence is Creative Commons CCZero (license_id 'cc-zero' in https://data.stadt-zuerich.ch/api/3/action/package_show?id=sid_stapo_aktueller_hundebestand_monat_od1003, read 2026-10-21). The register gives no owner's name or address; HID is a holder number, and the place is a statistical quarter of the city.
